name: Edgeless Listening
description: Listen without any edge to the self and take in the feeling of every near heart.

name: Open Comfort
description: Open the whole spirit as a comfort to the hurt and let their pain flow in.

name: Mood Hold
description: Hold the mood of a crowd in place so that it neither rises nor falls.

name: Spite Fade
description: Let hostile spite fade as it meets a spirit with no edge for it to strike.

name: Vast Hearing
description: Hear all hearts in a great region and place the user's presence beside any of them.

name: Grief Dissolve
description: Dissolve the grief and fear of a whole host into a long quiet release.

name: Shared Heartbeat
description: Give a host one steady heartbeat that mends their spirits and steels their will.

name: Hostile Hush
description: Hush the hostile feeling of a field until the foes forget why they came.

name: Hearts Met
description: The school's pillar in which every heart is met and strengthened in a measure set by the user's reserve.

name: Peace Offered
description: The school's last offer that holds out peace so fully that hostile wills lay down by the user's reserve.

name: Unnumbered Chorus
description: Raise every heart in reach into one feeling and halt a vast host at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Single Heart
description: Every living heart in reach feels as one and no energy mechanic explains why none can act against it; use is a consequence event.
